vault_line: I brought the Maccy out (I brought the bang)
bar: I brought the Maccy out (I brought the bang)
chip_form: I brought the Maccy out (I brought the bang)
note_excerpt: “Maccy,” refers to the Military Armament Corporation Model 10, otherwise known as the M-10 or MAC-10. It’s a compact machine pistol that was designed and developed by Gordon B. Ingram in 1964. It’s often name-dropped in Hip Hop.
